audited_binaries.head: target/release/shux rebuilt from 8f5ebf8 during this audit — `shux version` reports `0.46.7 (8f5ebf8)`

screenshot_provenance.generated_by: this audit, from the daemon's own rasterizer via `pane snapshot`
screenshot_provenance.baseline_policy: No expected PNG was minted. Every `-expected.png` is the SAME scene with each `CSI n b` replaced by n literal copies of the character, shot through the SAME binary — ECMA-48 8.3.103's own definition of REP used as the oracle. The `-diff.png` files are pixel_verify output.
screenshot_provenance.arm_labelling: Every metric JSON carries `binary`, `role` and `expected_status`; base-binary artifacts are prefixed `negative-control-`.

pixel_metric_thresholds: exact — max_pixel_diff_ratio 0, max_mean_channel_delta 0, on every entry

negative_control.why_not_in_pixel_metrics: It is the comparator's fail-proof, not a gate result. Listing it under pixel_metrics would trip scripts/check-progress.sh, which requires every pixel_metrics entry to have status == "pass". A reader must not mistake it for the gate finding a defect in the fix: status=fail is this arm's PASS condition.
negative_control.what_it_proves: The identical scene through the PRE-FIX binary loses its rule, CJK run, combining cluster, DEC line-drawing edge and ZWJ run. The comparator therefore detects the real issue-122 defect, not merely injected noise.

colour_probes: Every daemon-backed capture in this audit emits and asserts truecolor (rgb 120,220,180), 256-indexed (idx 208 and idx 1) and basic ANSI (idx 4). Verified in the canonical cell frame, not just the text capture.

rich_tui.replay_result: byte-identical text, cells and pixels between base@e856793 and head@8f5ebf8

leaks: zero — every daemon-backed run used an isolated XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and shux_harness_assert_no_daemon (pidfile only, never a pgrep/pkill substring match). Post-run process table carries no shux, vim, nvim, htop, btop, lazygit or less residue.
regenerate: SHUX_BIN=<binary> LABEL=<label> .shux/scripts/issue_122_evidence.sh   (EXPECT_DEFECT=1 for the base arm)
cargo test -p shux-vt --test rep && cargo test -p shux --test rep_pane_e2e
